title: Atlas replay
description: Forensic reconstruction of the stored decision-time envelope. Not model re-execution.

decision.description: The decision as it was made. Never re-decided against today.

knowable_at_the_time.description: The stored decision-time envelope: credential scopes and state, role and entitlement capabilities, organization, and the evidence reference supplied.

changed_since.description: Named explicitly. An empty array means no later change has been admitted, which is a finding rather than an absence of one.

replay_class.description: Carried in the payload rather than only in documentation, so what is offered cannot be mistaken by an integrator or overstated by us.
